en.hubeali:
From him, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Yahya Bin Al Mubarak, from Buhloul Bin Muslim, from Hafs, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who dies in less that fourteen days (of illness), his death would have been a sudden death’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the above Hadith from Ya’qub ibn Yazid from Yahya ibn Mubarak from Buhlul ibn Muslim from Hafs who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
if one dies from an illness within fourteen days, such death is a sudden death.”
